units.source_text: 源氏公子在石山寺礼拜完毕，即将离寺之时，

en.t: Just as Prince Genji had finished worshipping at Ishiyama Temple and was about to leave,

units.source_text: 右卫门佐又从京中来寺迎接，并且向公子谢罪，

en.t: the Assistant Captain of the Right Gate Guards came again from the capital to meet him at the temple, and apologized to the prince,

units.source_text: 说那天不曾随公子赴石山寺，甚是抱歉。

en.t: saying that he was deeply sorry he had not accompanied the prince to Ishiyama Temple that day.

units.source_text: 这小君在童子年代，曾经深蒙公子怜爱，官居五位，备受恩宠。

en.t: When this young lord had still been a boy, he had been greatly cherished by the prince, had risen to the fifth rank, and had received exceptional favor.

units.source_text: 但当公子突遭横祸，流放须磨之时，

en.t: But when the prince was suddenly struck by misfortune and exiled to Suma,

units.source_text: 他因忌惮当时权势，不敢随公子赴须磨，却跟姐夫到了常陆。

en.t: he was afraid of the powerful people of the time and did not dare follow the prince to Suma, instead going with his brother-in-law to Hitachi.

units.source_text: 因此近几年来，公子对他略感不快，但亦不形于色。

en.t: Because of this, in recent years the prince had felt somewhat displeased with him, though he never showed it outwardly.

units.source_text: 虽然不及往年那样亲信，但也将他归入心腹人之列。

en.t: Although the prince no longer trusted him as closely as before, he still counted him among his inner circle.

units.source_text: 常陆介的儿子纪伊守，现已调任，但仍只是个河内守。

en.t: The son of the Assistant Governor of Hitachi, the Governor of Kii, had now been transferred, but only to the post of Governor of Kawachi.

units.source_text: 其弟右近将监，当时曾被削去官职，随公子流放须磨，现在便走了红运。

en.t: His younger brother, the Captain of the Right Inner Palace Guards, had been stripped of office at the time and had followed the prince into exile at Suma, and now his fortunes had risen.

units.source_text: 小君和纪伊守等人看了，都很眼热，痛悔当时不该产生趋炎附势之心。

en.t: Seeing this, the young lord, the Governor of Kii, and the others were all intensely envious, and bitterly regretted having given in to the impulse to follow those in power.
